status: OUT INDEFINITELY - joint Eagles/agent statement Oct 19: deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli (blood clots in both lungs); on injured reserve since Oct 17; no return timetable announced
detail: Monday Oct 19 joint statement from the Eagles and agent Nicole Lynn: further testing after the initial London diagnosis of a left calf superficial vein thrombosis established DVT and blood clots in both lungs. Clinically stable, no significant functional limitations, on anticoagulation (blood thinners), no contact football during treatment; team expects a full recovery with no long-term effects and Hurts remains involved/conditioning. No return date or timetable announced. REPORTED (not in the statement): expected to miss multiple months; ESPN headline says out for season, NFL Network reports likely out for rest of 2026 - treat as reporting, not team confirmation. Supersedes the Oct 17 superficial-calf-clot framing. Tanner McKee started Sunday's 25-14 loss to Carolina and remains the current starter.
